name: shyam-claude-plugins
description: Workflow plugins for Claude Code — adversarial review loops and engineering standards.

plugins.name: brain-hand
plugins.description: Run work through two adversarial agents — a read-only brain that specs and judges, and a hand that builds — arguing until one is genuinely convinced, with a shared blackboard so nothing is re-derived. For work where 'it ran without errors' is not the same as 'it does the job'.
